description: This file defines the EntityOne class, which implements an entity operation for the mini-language in the OFBiz framework. It handles the <entity-one> element, performing entity lookups using a PrimaryKeyFinder, and includes a factory class for creating instances.

classes.name: EntityOne
classes.description: Implements the <entity-one> element, performing entity lookup operations based on primary keys, with validation and error handling.

classes.name: EntityOneFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating EntityOne instances, associated with the <entity-one> element.

methods.name: EntityOne
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity operation, validates attributes, and sets up the primary key finder.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the entity lookup using the delegator and primary key finder, handles exceptions, and logs warnings.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information, specifically the entity name involved.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the entity-one element with the entity name.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create an EntityOne instance from XML element and method context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the element this factory creates ('entity-one').
